Public-accommodation, employment and housing protections covering visitors, GI hate-crime statute with reporting machinery, shield law, X markers, ranked 'Most Protective'. National entry screening and passport rules still bind, capping the score below Low Risk.

In-force 2025 facility exclusion in state buildings, March 2026 court ruling barring birth-certificate changes, religious-denial service law, no GI anti-discrimination or hate-crime coverage, ranked among worst for adult-targeting legislation.

Governor's women's-bill-of-rights order endorsing single-sex spaces, surgery-based document rules, and documented custody harm: trans woman celled with male sex offender, assault claims dismissed by court — state-tolerated impunity in detention.
